  service="doctor",status="completed",target="shop"
doctor_diagnosis_duration_seconds	HISTOGRAM	诊断开始执行至终态的耗时。
  service="doctor",status="completed",target="shop"
doctor_llm_budget_blocked	GAUGE	真实诊断是否因费用不足停止启动。
  service="doctor"
doctor_llm_budget_blocked_reason	GAUGE	阻止真实诊断的原因，当前原因为1。
  reason="accounting_guard",service="doctor"
  reason="other",service="doctor"
  reason="request_reservation",service="doctor"
  reason="total_limit",service="doctor"

  currency="USD",service="doctor"
doctor_llm_budget_spent	GAUGE	当前账户费用与预留额，单位由 currency 指定。
  currency="USD",service="doctor"

  model="mock",service="doctor"
doctor_llm_cost_total	COUNTER	模型结算费用及未知预留额，单位由 currency 指定。
  currency="USD",model="mock",service="doctor"

  direction="output",model="mock",service="doctor"
